instruction: Format the titles of slides 2, 4, and 6 with green text and italics.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing title colors to green (RGB 0,128,0) and applying italic formatting in slides 2, 4, and 6 (0-indexed: 1, 3, 5). Evaluator reads the presentation file and checks if the title text formatting matches the expected color and italic properties. Partial credit is given per slide: each slide contributes equally to the final score.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both required properties: green color (RGB 0,128,0) and italic formatting
Getter extracts title formatting from specified slides (1, 3, 5 - corresponding to slides 2, 4, 6)
Metric correctly compares color using exact RGB tuple match
Metric correctly compares italic property with proper boolean handling
Postconfig properly saves the file before reading, ensuring changes are persisted
Partial credit logic appropriately scores each slide independently and averages results
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses fields properly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: Getter uses heuristic to identify title (first text shape with content). In edge cases with unusual slide layouts, this might select a non-title shape. Consider using shape.is_placeholder or checking for specific placeholder types to more robustly identify title shapes.
Consider adding validation that the slide actually has a title shape before attempting to extract formatting, though current implementation handles missing titles gracefully by skipping them.
